INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( NOTIFICATION_NO, RECEIVER_MEMBER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, TITLE, MESSAGE, LINK_URL, REFERENCE_TYPE, REFERENCE_NO, IS_READ, CREATED_AT ) SELECT SEQ_NOTIFICATION_NO.NEXTVAL, M.MEMBER_NO, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{message}, #{linkUrl}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceNo}, 'N', SYSDATE FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.ROLE = 'ADMIN' AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( NOTIFICATION_NO, RECEIVER_MEMBER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, TITLE, MESSAGE, LINK_URL, REFERENCE_TYPE, REFERENCE_NO, IS_READ, CREATED_AT ) SELECT SEQ_NOTIFICATION_NO.NEXTVAL, B.MEMBER_NO, #{notification.notificationType}, #{notification.title}, #{notification.message}, #{notification.linkUrl}, #{notification.referenceType}, #{notification.referenceNo}, 'N', SYSDATE FROM BUSINESS B JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( NOTIFICATION_NO, RECEIVER_MEMBER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, TITLE, MESSAGE, LINK_URL, REFERENCE_TYPE, REFERENCE_NO, IS_READ, CREATED_AT ) SELECT SEQ_NOTIFICATION_NO.NEXTVAL, TARGET_MEMBER.MEMBER_NO, #{notification.notificationType}, #{notification.title}, #{notification.message}, #{notification.linkUrl}, #{notification.referenceType}, #{notification.referenceNo}, 'N', SYSDATE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT B.MEMBER_NO FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = OI.BUSINESS_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) TARGET_MEMBER

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( NOTIFICATION_NO, RECEIVER_MEMBER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, TITLE, MESSAGE, LINK_URL, REFERENCE_TYPE, REFERENCE_NO, IS_READ, CREATED_AT ) SELECT SEQ_NOTIFICATION_NO.NEXTVAL, TARGET_MEMBER.MEMBER_NO, #{notification.notificationType}, #{notification.title}, #{notification.message}, #{notification.linkUrl}, #{notification.referenceType}, #{notification.referenceNo}, 'N', SYSDATE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT B.MEMBER_NO FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = OI.BUSINESS_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) TARGET_MEMBER
